# Reverse Engineering: fine-ties-run.freebuff.dev

Analysis date: 2026-08-10. All findings extracted directly from the live deployment
(raw HTML, served source modules, embedded sourcemaps, exposed config files).

## TL;DR

- A **portfolio website for a fictional engineer, "Alex Carter"** — React SPA generated by
  the **Vly / freebuff.com AI app builder** (VlyToolbar + `@vly-ai/integrations` injected).
- The deployment is a **Vite dev server (WebContainer preview)** — not a production build.
  That means **the entire project source, configs, and sourcemaps are publicly readable**
  (`/src/main.tsx`, `/package.json`, `/vite.config.ts`, `/src/convex/...` all served as plain files).
- Backend is **Convex** (`enduring-quail-323`) with **Convex Auth** (email OTP + anonymous
  guest + a federated freebuff.com customJwt provider).
- App is fully functional: `/` landing, `/auth` (sign in), `/dashboard` (protected placeholder),
  `*` 404.

## What the site is

App ID: `fine-ties-run` (from `VITE_VLY_APP_ID`). Running on the freebuff.dev preview domain,
embedded as an iframe (the app posts `iframe-route-change` messages to `window.parent` and
listens for `navigate` back/forward messages).

The persona is template/filler content: "Alex Carter", 8+ years experience, projects named
Pulseboard / Relay / Northstar / Vaultline / Drift CLI / Shelf, testimonials from invented
people, contact `hello@alexcarter.dev`, all project links pointing at `example.com` / `github.com`.

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Build | Vite 7 (dev server), TypeScript 5.9 |
| UI | React 19, react-router v7 (from `react-router`), Tailwind CSS v4 (`@tailwindcss/vite`) |
| Components | shadcn-style on Radix primitives (button, card, badge, input, input-otp, sonner toasts) |
| Icons | lucide-react |
| Animation | framer-motion, tw-animate-css |
| Backend | Convex `^1.30` + `@convex-dev/auth` (`^0.0.90`) |
| Platform | `@vly-ai/integrations` (VlyToolbar, runtime-error reporting), `@zumer/snapdom` |
| Package manager | bun (per README); dependencies also used: react-hook-form, zod, recharts, hono, axios |

## Architecture

### Routes (`src/main.tsx`)
- `/` → `Landing` (lazy)
- `/auth` → `AuthPage` with `redirectAfterAuth="/dashboard"` (lazy)
- `/dashboard` → `RequireAuth` → `Dashboard` (lazy)
- `*` → `NotFound` (lazy)
- `RouteSyncer` — iframe/postMessage bridge for route sync + history back/forward
- `RootErrorBoundary` + `ToolbarErrorBoundary` — VlyToolbar crash can't blank the app
- `ConvexAuthProvider` wraps everything; `VlyToolbar` injected read-only at root

### Landing page (`src/pages/Landing.tsx`, ~53 KB, all one file)
Sections (all client-side, data defined as static arrays in the same file):
1. `Navbar` — fixed, scroll-spy, scroll-progress bar, mobile menu, theme toggle, "Sign in" + "Hire me"
2. `Hero` — headline, stats, socials, animated "code card" (`developer.ts`), floating tech chips
3. `Marquee` — infinite tech-name ticker (CSS animation)
4. `Projects` — filterable grid (All / Full-stack / Frontend / Backend / Open source), framer-motion layout animations
5. `About` — profile card, facts, values
6. `Experience` — timeline (4 jobs)
7. `Skills` — 4 groups
8. `Testimonials` — 3 cards
9. `Contact` + `Footer`
- Theme: manual light/dark via `localStorage["theme"]` + `.dark` class (no next-themes despite it being in deps)
- A11y: aria-labels, focus-friendly buttons; `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"`

### Auth (`src/pages/Auth.tsx`, `src/hooks/use-auth.ts`, `src/components/RequireAuth.tsx`)
- Two-step flow: email → 6-digit OTP (InputOTP) → verify; plus "Continue as Guest" (anonymous)
- `resolveRedirectAfterAuth` — same-origin `returnTo` query param, falls back to `/dashboard`
- `useAuth` = `useConvexAuth` + `useQuery(api.users.currentUser)` + `useAuthActions`
- `RequireAuth` → spinner while loading; redirects signed-out users to `/auth?returnTo=<path>`

### Dashboard (`src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`)
- Placeholder: "Your dashboard is ready — Replace this starter content...". Welcome, `{user.name}`, sign-out.

## Backend (Convex)

- Deployment: `enduring-quail-323` (`https://enduring-quail-323.convex.cloud`),
  site: `https://enduring-quail-323.convex.site`
- Error monitoring target: `https://harmless-tapir-303.convex.site/runtime-error`
- `src/convex/schema.ts` — `authTables` + `users` table:
  `{ name?, image?, email?, emailVerificationTime?, isAnonymous?, role? }` (index on email),
  roles: `admin | user | member`. `schemaValidation: false`. No other tables — app writes nothing.
- `src/convex/auth.ts` — `convexAuth({ providers: [emailOtp, Anonymous] })`
- `src/convex/users.ts` — single public query `currentUser` (wraps `getAuthUserId`)
- `src/convex/http.ts` — `auth.addHttpRoutes(http)` → OIDC discovery at `/.well-known/openid-configuration`
- `src/convex/auth.config.ts` — two providers:
  1. `{ domain: CONVEX_SITE_URL, applicationID: "convex" }` — self-issued JWTs (dev sign-in)
  2. `customJwt` — issuer `https://freebuff.com`, JWKS `https://freebuff.com/api/web/.well-known/jwks.json`,
     applicationID `vly-convex`, RS256 — lets signed-in freebuff.com users carry identity into the app
- `src/convex/auth/emailOtp.ts` — 6-digit numeric code, 15-minute TTL; delivery via
  `POST https://auth.freebuff.app/send_otp` with a **hardcoded API key** (see Security)

### Convex API surface (probed)
`POST /api/list_functions` on the cloud deployment → **404** (not enumerable). The backend is
otherwise only reachable through the client SDK — no extra public HTTP endpoints beyond auth.

## Security findings

1. **Hardcoded API key in source** — `src/convex/auth/emailOtp.ts` contains
   `x-api-key: fb_email_2crN1hqIArZP2bEfvjp5Qik4` for `https://auth.freebuff.app/send_otp`.
   Anyone who reads the (publicly served) source can send OTP emails through freebuff's
   endpoint. This key is committed in the repo/deployment and should be rotated and moved
   to a server-side env var.
2. **Entire source exposed** — the preview serves the raw project: `package.json`,
   `vite.config.ts`, `tsconfig*.json`, `convex.json`, README, every `src/**` file, and
   **inline base64 sourcemaps containing the original TypeScript sources**. A production
   build would hide most of this.
3. **Anonymous sign-in enabled** — anyone can click "Continue as Guest" and get a valid
   session into `/dashboard`.
4. **Federated trust in freebuff.com** — the customJwt provider trusts freebuff.com's JWKS;
   tokens it signs are accepted as `vly-convex` identities.
5. **Dev-only endpoints live in prod-ish URL** — `/@vite/client`, `@react-refresh`,
   html-proxy URLs all functional; the whole dev-server surface is reachable.
6. Convex URLs and deployment name are guessable/disclosed — standard for Convex, but worth
   noting nothing secret should live in the `VITE_*` env block.

## Recovering the source

Because the dev server serves modules directly, recovery was trivial:

```
curl https://fine-ties-run.freebuff.dev/src/main.tsx        # entry, env vars inlined
curl https://fine-ties-run.freebuff.dev/src/pages/Landing.tsx  # etc.
```

Each module ends with `//# sourceMappingURL=data:application/json;base64,...` whose
`sourcesContent` holds the **original untranspiled TypeScript**. These were decoded and saved
locally (Landing ~53 KB, Auth, use-auth, RequireAuth, convex files, configs).

## Notable trivia

- `vite.config.ts` force-dedupes React (`dedupe: ["react", ...]`) because `@vly-ai/integrations`
  would otherwise load its own React copy → "Invalid hook call" errors.
- VlyToolbar is a read-only element-picker: uses `snapdom` + walks React fibers
  (`__reactFiber$`) to annotate selected elements with component names for the AI builder.
- The `/auth` page footer reads "Secured by freebuff.com".
- Source paths reveal the build host: `/home/daytona/codebase` (Daytona/WebContainer).
- Local workspace note: this repo contains a hand-written, cleaner re-implementation of the
  same Alex Carter portfolio (components split per-file, no Convex/auth) — same design, built
  differently.
